title: Mauna Kea Magic | KEY.co
description_expanded: For those guests staying at Mauna Kea Magic who want the benefits of staying in a luxury private home but also to enjoy an experience as if they were a hotel guest there is an ability to opt into the Mauna Kea Club program. Only guests staying in Mauna Kea resort homes where the owners are members of the Mauna Kea Club have the option of enjoying this option. The program includes charging privileges at two hotels (Mauna Kea Beach Hotel and Hapuna Westin), use of each hotel’s pools, beach chairs, and hotel parking. The hotel requires guests who opt in to pay a daily fee per home, not per guest, to the hotel directly. Guests who opt in must sign up for all nights of their stay. For guests who want to participate, advance registration is required with the hotel. Inside, two master suites feature king-size beds and private bathrooms, while the third suite offers two queen beds. The separate Ohana Studio Suite serves as a private hideaway with a king bed, kitchenette, and sleeper sofa. Beyond the home, guests can explore the community garden or enjoy the nearby Amaui Club, featuring a pool with a waterslide, fitness center, and serene lounges with sweeping ocean views. With access to the exclusive Mauna Kea Club Amenity program, guests can also enjoy the unparalleled beauty of Mauna Kea Beach and the luxury of two world-class hotels. This retreat offers an unforgettable escape in paradise, where luxury and nature combine to create cherished memories.
